# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are applied to the latest release candidate. Older prereleases may be asked to upgrade before a fix is investigated.

| Version | Supported |
|---|---|
| `0.1.0-rc.x` | Yes |
| Earlier prototypes | No |

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not disclose a suspected vulnerability in a public issue, discussion, or pull request.

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/solu199/html-surface-three/security/advisories/new) and include:

- affected package version
- impact and attack scenario
- minimal reproduction or proof of concept
- affected browser, OS, Three.js version, and Backend
- any known mitigation

The maintainer will acknowledge a complete report when practical, validate the impact, and coordinate a fix and disclosure. Please allow time for investigation before publishing details.

Never include passwords, npm tokens, session cookies, private user data, or unrelated secrets in a report.
